lessons: NIFTY's 09:16 bullish read (breakout above prior high 22,580, 44/50 breadth) failed: price fell back through the 22,585 POC/gamma flip and closed 22,317, -0.90%. The +0.32% gap was global carry-over, not Indian demand, and faded.

The ORB put at 10:35 (break of 55,027 at the 55,000 put-OI wall, relative volume 0.88) earned only +0.32R in 102 min. BANKNIFTY ground lower without extension, so the 390-pt target was unrealistic on a balance-leaning day.

The desk kept buying premium (two long puts) with IV rich ×1.27–1.43 and a record of realised/implied 0.69× and 0% of sessions above implied. A bear_put_spread was on the 14:15 menu and should have been preferred.

The 14:15 vwap_trend put entered at -0.89% with Supertrend long, CVD rising and the 54,788 gamma flip nearby. It was late-day continuation into positive gamma, and theta and the square-off cost -0.20R.
Brent rose +2.86% intraday and NIFTY fell 0.9%, yet crude (IC +0.22 at 30m, t 2.0) only explains and doesn't vote. Today's crude/equity link deserves to be logged as a test case.

lessons: All four trades were long premium on a Wednesday with IV rich (×1.17–1.40 vs realised) while the record shows realised/implied 0.63–0.67× and 0% sessions where realised beat implied; three died on 45-min time exits. Structure, not direction, lost the day.

BANKNIFTY ORB call at 09:36 was bought on a ×0.76 'cheap' vol reading from a +2.7σ VWAP stretch with relative volume 0.88; the move stalled and decayed. Opening realised spikes are not a basis for calling premium cheap.

The 13:07 NIFTY put used 8 lots (double others) at -2.9σ below VWAP on a day 65% undetermined; NIFTY then balanced around 22,620–22,660 and closed at 22,625. Size followed conviction 0.56, which the setup record (33% won, -0.27R) doesn't support.

The BANKNIFTY trend_break ignored its own against-flag: narrow sell-off, 50% of bank stocks up, equal weight -0.08% vs index -0.44%. Equal weight closed +0.14% while the index sat -0.30%; breadth divergence called the stall.

The only winner was va_reversion in a balance tape, taken against a bullish bias, with a near target (POC 22,686). The bias flipped ~19 times on NIFTY; on such days reversion-to-value fits better than breakouts.

lessons: The 09:38 NIFTY ORB was the day's edge: fresh close above OR high 22,752 with VWAP +2.2σ, and the only moment realised (17.3) exceeded implied (13.5). The 22950CE hit its 60% target by 10:01, delivering +2.09R.

lessons: The 10:20 NIFTY long call bought premium at IV 11.6 into a desk record where realised vol has never exceeded implied in 10 sessions (0.63×). The trade was +0.07R EV, essentially a coin flip, and it bled via a 0.3 premium stop in 27 minutes.

Direction was right: NIFTY closed 23,119, above the opening-range high and the prior-day high. The stop was the failure. A 0.3 premium stop on a Δ0.42 call exited on noise well before the flag-midpoint invalidation at 23,017.80. Stop and thesis were misaligned.
